This scene:
这是古代的故事。孟子小的时候，他的爸爸很早就去世了。从他的家到墓地很近，所以他每天老是从早到晚去墓地跟朋友们玩玩儿。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 这是古代的故事：这是一个古代的故事
- 孟子小的时候：better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 从他的家到墓地很近：他的家离墓地很近
- 所以他每天老是从早到晚去墓地跟朋友们玩玩儿：delete老是；玩儿，V.V. is used to make requests or plans

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 从他的家到墓地很近：他的家离墓地很近，Use 离 to describe the distance between two places; 从……到…… normally needs a distance expression such as a length or 不远. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 玩玩儿：玩，Verb reduplication here suggests doing something briefly or casually, which conflicts with an activity lasting from morning to evening. [rule: none]
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 这是古代的故事。孟子小的时候，他的爸爸很早就去世了。：在古代，有一个小男孩叫孟子。他小时候，爸爸很早就去世了。Introduce the main character clearly as a boy named Mengzi at his first mention before using pronouns or family references. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]

items.reason: “从……到……”不能直接搭配“很近”表示两地距离，改为“离”正确。
从早到晚的持续活动不适合用“玩玩儿”这种动词重叠形式。
孟子首次出现时应先清楚介绍人物，改写后的指代和人物介绍都正确。
